description: 2021 Amazon Last Mile winner (jpt-amz: Cook, Held, Helsgaun) run locally on the 300 val routes

code.local_changes:
Local changes to jpt-amz at commit dc4ebc0aa091d4d1eb7dc7d9b9b2d8f8c19664ce (full diff: runs/jpt/local_changes.diff).
None of them touches the method (zone rules, history, constraints, LKH search).
1. LKH-AMZ/Makefile: make -j 16 -> -j 3 (3-thread limit on this laptop).
2. LKH-AMZ/solve and LKH-AMZ/merge: THREADS=16 -> 3 (at most 3 LKH processes at once).
3. model_apply.sh: gawk -> awk (gawk is not installed; the call only prints field 1 or 2).
4. model_apply.sh: optional env vars JPT_TIME_LIMIT_1 / JPT_TIME_LIMIT_2 override the per-route LKH
   time limits that manage_running_time.py would otherwise derive from a 4 h, 16-core budget.
Dependency: natsort 8.4.0 (the only non-stdlib Python import, used by build_TSPLIB.py), installed with
pip --target into runs/jpt/pydeps and put on PYTHONPATH; nothing installed system-wide.
Build: LKH-AMZ (not -oldgcc) compiled with the system gcc 13.3.0, no warnings, no source edits.
model_build_outputs/ and model_apply_outputs/ created by hand: in rc-cli's Docker image they already exist, and model_build.sh only empties them

data.apply: 300 val routes (route_data without route_score, package_data, travel_times); no sequences

metric.direction: lower is better; 0 = driver's exact order

shortest_on_val.source: orders from results/v0_shortest_val.json (OR-Tools GLS, 10 s/route, as run_plain_baseline.py), re-scored here; max |diff| vs stored scores = 8.33e-17

comparisons.jpt_minus_best_v0_variant: not run: v0.json did not exist when this was scored
comparisons.jpt_minus_best_rules_arm: not run: rules_baseline.json did not exist when this was scored

evaluation_side.note: hidden evaluation set, ~3,000 routes, contest time limits; not our val set

training_side.source: Cook, Held, Helsgaun arXiv 2112.15192 (from a summary, not read verbatim here)
training_side.note: their training routes are also their history pool's neighbours; our val routes are held out from the build data
